answer_raw:
The newest flagship is the **iPhone 18 Pro Max**, which arrived in October 2026 [3].

The price for the iPhone 18 Pro Max has increased compared to the previous generation due to global RAM shortages affecting production costs [3]. I didn't find the exact MSRP for the iPhone 18 Pro Max, so you would need to check the Apple Store for the current starting price [1].

Upgrading from an iPhone 14 is **worth it** if you want a significant leap in performance and features, as those moving from an iPhone 16 or older will notice the most substantial changes [3].

**Comparison of upward paths**

*   **iPhone 18 Pro Max** — The current top-tier choice; the upgrade will feel massive compared to a 14, though the price premium is higher due to component costs [3].
*   **iPhone 17 Pro Max** — A predecessor to the current flagship; it features a 6.3-inch 120Hz ProMotion display, 40W charging, and 256GB base storage as of August 2026 [2].
*   **iPhone Duo** — The latest lineup released in October 2026 [1].
